title: Sean Payton says Bo Nix could be back for OTAs and be full go well ahead of training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton says Bo Nix could be back for OTAs and be full go well ahead of training camp
sources.description: Denver Broncos Head Coach Sean Payton met with the media today after the Broncos’ second rookie minicamp practice and provided a positive update on the status of quarterback Bo Nix. Payton told reporters that there is a “good chance” we see quarterback Bo Nix on the field in some capacity for June’s minicamp practices, but […]
